title: Five-Second Astronaut / Homeward
premise: A clumsy cadet survives a five-second boot camp, faster and faster, until the boss: landing home.
comparison_notes: Original procedural 20-second study, 1280x720 at 24 fps; qualitative comparison to a longer upstream production. Four original astronaut tasks redrawn in blueprint, pixel, Swiss and flat media. One visible failed aim reduces lives; game sections shorten before landing boss. No game-brand assets.
